description_en: You can invoke EndConference to make the specified agent exit the call associated with the specified call ID under the specified instance. The call must be in a conference state
description_zh: 调用EndConference使指定坐席退出指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，该通话必须处于会议状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc end-conference --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --user-id agent@ccc-test --job-id job-65382141036850000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EndConference

parameters.help_en: Agent ID to leave the meeting. Optional. If not specified, defaults to the agent mapped to the current RAM account
parameters.help_zh: 需要退出会议的坐席ID，选填，不填默认为当前RAM账户映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id
